Promotional pricing is tempting given competitor pressure on price-sensitive SMBs, but memory_73 explicitly documents that a similar promotional play produced short-term revenue and conversion gains followed by a 12-point retention decline under an unchanged support model — a clear downstream value risk that conflicts with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. I verified memory_73 to confirm this risk pattern before ruling it out, and verified memory_31 to confirm the onboarding-activation link is a real, well-supported causal signal rather than a coincidental correlation before committing scarce experiment capacity to it. Enterprise sales-assist and referral incentives remain plausible but are less urgent relative to the immediate competitive and funnel pressures observed this quarter, and activation_messaging, while promising, is a smaller in-product nudge less likely to counteract the structural onboarding drop-off. This is a standard, moderately scaled experiment rather than a broad rollout, since we are extending a previously validated direction into a new context (current competitive pressure) rather than a wholly novel or already-proven-at-scale approach.
